question: At Nintendo’s FY2020 results, what profit attributable to owners of parent did it guide for the year ending March 2021? Compare it with the just-reported year, discuss the risk to the supply of components, and forecast the full-year actual relative to guidance (within means ±2% of the guide, inclusive). State one base-case direction (lower, within, or higher), the main driver, an alternative and an observable signal that would change the call. Cite PDF pages for material claims and show the inputs to derived figures.
